info.name: SAP HANA Cloud REST Alerts Metrics API
Retrieve Metric Values for a Service Instance

params.name: serviceInstanceId
params.description: The unique identifier of the SAP HANA Cloud service instance for which to retrieve alerts, metrics, or metering data.

params.name: metricType
params.description: Filter metrics by type. Specify one or more metric types to retrieve specific categories of performance data.

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description: Start timestamp for the metrics query window in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description: End timestamp for the metrics query window in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: granularity
params.description: The aggregation granularity for metric data points. Determines the time interval between data points in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves database performance and resource utilization metrics for a specific SAP HANA Cloud service instance. Metrics include CPU usage, memory consumption, disk utilization, connection counts, statement execution statistics, and other operational indicators. Data can be queried for specific time ranges and metric types.
